title: 第1章 星河圣女拒绝侍寝第2章 第一个伴生天赋
slug: 暮年太子每天增加一点精神
content_zh:
“父皇嫌孤老迈，朝堂议事，竟不许孤再参与半点。”
“宫中嫔妃，视孤如冢中枯骨，避之唯恐不及。”
“呵，就连那小小星河宗的圣女，吃了孤的东西，受了孤的人情，竟敢拒绝孤的召见，好，很好！”
……
文华殿中，七十二岁的垂暮太子夏无恙怒火滔天，狠狠地摔着面前的东西。
烛火摇曳，映照出他那张因为愤怒而扭曲的老脸，奏折被摔在地上，朱笔在宣纸上划出一道刺目的划痕。
“混账，都觉得孤要死了，就可以任意欺辱孤了吗？”
一把抓起案上的茶盏，狠狠地砸向墙壁，滚烫的茶水溅在太监安德禄的身上，疼得他瑟缩了一下，扑通一声跪倒在地，额头紧紧地贴着冰冷的地砖。
门外候着的太监宫女们脸色一变，面面相觑一阵，有人脸上浮现出奇异之色，似乎已经想好了该怎么向身后的主子汇报。
夏无恙并非此方世界之人，他来自于地球，因为救人身死，胎穿到了大夏皇朝，运气极好地投胎到了皇室，还是皇后的第一个儿子。
从小觉醒前世记忆，稍微展露些许，便让群臣惊为天人，早早被立为太子，端的是风光无限。
原本想着早晚能够成为皇帝，今生荣华富贵享用不尽，没想到三十岁的时候被歹人偷袭，毁掉了修炼根基，彻底断送了他的前途。
在这个高武世界，不能修行跟废人没什么区别，尤其是作为一朝太子，原本前途无量的夏无恙，瞬间墙倒众人推。
昔日门庭若市的东宫，转瞬门可罗雀；那些谄媚逢迎的宗门帮派，纷纷与他划清界限；就连向来恭顺老实的皇弟们，眼中也开始闪烁着野心的光芒。
幸得帝后怜惜，一直没有废弃他的太子之位，这些年他遍访名医，求尽奇药，想要恢复根基，再次走上修炼之路。
可惜并没有什么效果，希望一次次破灭，渐渐地将他磋磨得性情乖戾，身边之人纷纷远离。
晃眼之间，他已经七十有二，早已绝了重修之念，只求在锦衣玉食中了此残生。
没想到在召见星河宗圣女苏星晚进宫侍寝的时候，竟然遭到了拒绝，要知道星河宗只是一个中小宗门，以前上赶着想要把自家圣女送给他，生怕他不收，还许出了各种条件，当时夏无恙看对方还算恭敬，虽然没有收下苏星晚，却也给了对方好处。
现在夏无恙想要让对方履行承诺了，星河宗却直接拒绝他这个当朝太子，丝毫不将昔日的恩情和承诺放在心上，可见他这个垂暮太子都沦落到什么地步了。
“哈哈……哈哈哈哈……”

想到这里，夏无恙忍不住放声大笑，原以为穿越以后即将走上人生巅峰，没想到此生过得还是这般憋屈无奈。
所谓太子尊荣，不过是镜花水月。
“早知如此……”
或许就不应该穿越的，比起这些年经历的痛苦，比起承受一个个死去亲人的痛苦，尤其是母后洛锦的死，些许荣华富贵又算得了什么。
若是不曾穿越，就不用忍受母亲、红颜知己、左膀右臂……的一个个惨死。
“咚……”
就在这时，胸腔突然传来一声沉闷的震动，那声音如同晨钟暮鼓，让他浑身一颤。
紧接着，心窍处迸发出七彩霞光，一枚生有七窍的琉璃奇石浮现，瞬息之间与他完全融合。
夏无恙瞳孔骤缩，恍惚间，似乎有万千明悟涌上心头。
沉寂多年的身体泛起了久违的活力，他能够清晰地感知到，某种亘古未有的天赋正在他的体内觉醒。
七窍玲珑！
content_en:
"My father felt that I was old, so he didn't allow me to participate in the affairs of the court."
"The concubines in the palace regard the orphans as the dry bones in the grave, and avoid them for fear of being out of reach."
"Oh, even that little saint girl of Xinghe Sect, who ate Gu's food and received Gu's favor, dared to refuse Gu's summons, good, very good!"
…
In the Wenhua Palace, the 72-year-old crown prince Xia Wuyang was furious and threw things in front of him.
The candlelight flickered, reflecting his old face twisted with anger. The memorial was thrown to the ground, and the ink pen made a dazzling scratch on the rice paper.
"You bastard, you think I'm going to die, so you can humiliate me at will?"
He grabbed the tea cup on the table and smashed it against the wall. The hot tea splashed on Eunuch Andre's body. He winced in pain and fell to his knees with a plop, his forehead pressed tightly against the cold floor tiles.
The faces of the eunuchs and maids waiting outside the door changed, and they looked at each other for a while. Some of them had strange expressions on their faces, as if they had already figured out how to report to the master behind them.
Xia Wuyang was not from this world. He came from the earth. Because he saved someone from death, he was transported to the Great Xia Dynasty. He was lucky enough to be reincarnated into the royal family and was the queen's first son.
Awakening the memory of his previous life since he was a child, and revealing a little bit of it, he shocked the officials and was established as a prince early, with unlimited glory.
He originally thought that he would become an emperor sooner or later and enjoy endless glory and wealth in this life. Unexpectedly, when he was thirty years old, he was attacked by gangsters, which destroyed his cultivation foundation and completely ruined his future.
In this world of high martial arts, being unable to practice is no different from being a useless person, especially as a former prince, Xia Wuyi, who originally had a bright future, was instantly overturned by everyone.
The East Palace, which used to be bustling with people, suddenly became empty; the flattering sects and gangs all drew a clear line with him; even the imperial brothers, who had always been respectful and honest, began to shine with ambition in their eyes.
Fortunately, the emperor and empress took pity on him and never gave up his position as prince. Over the years, he visited famous doctors and asked for all kinds of strange medicines, hoping to restore his foundation and embark on the path of cultivation again.
Unfortunately, it had no effect, and his hopes were dashed again and again, gradually turning him into a surly temperament and causing people around him to stay away.
In the blink of an eye, he was already seventy-two, and he had long given up the idea of ​​rebuilding his cultivation, and just wanted to live out his remaining days in rich clothes and fine food.
Unexpectedly, when he summoned Xinghe Sect Saint Su Xingwan to sleep in the palace, he was rejected. You must know that Xinghe Sect is only a small and medium-sized sect. In the past, he was eager to give his saint daughter to him, fearing that he would not accept it, and made various conditions. At that time, Xia Wuyang thought that the other party was quite respectful. Although he did not accept Su Xingwan, he also gave her benefits.
Now Xia Wuyang wanted to make the other party fulfill his promise, but the Xinghe Sect directly rejected him as the current prince, without caring about the past kindness and promises. This shows how low he, the dying prince, had fallen.
"Haha...hahahaha..."
Thinking of this, Xia Wuyang couldn't help but laugh loudly. He thought that he would reach the peak of his life after time travel, but he didn't expect that he would still be so frustrated and helpless in this life.
The so-called honor of the prince is nothing but a mirror.
"I had known this..."
Maybe he shouldn't time travel. Compared with the pain he has experienced over the years, compared with the pain of enduring the death of his relatives one after another, especially the death of his mother Luo Jin, a little glory and wealth are nothing.
If he had never traveled through time, he would not have had to endure the tragic deaths of his mother, his confidante, his right-hand man... one by one.
"Boom..."
At this moment, a dull vibration suddenly came from his chest. The sound was like morning bells and evening drums, making him tremble all over.
Immediately afterwards, colorful rays of light burst out from the heart orifice, and a glazed stone with seven orifices appeared, completely merging with him in an instant.
Xia Wuyan's pupils suddenly shrank, and in a daze, it seemed as if thousands of enlightenments came to his mind.
A body that has been silent for many yearsHis body was filled with vitality that he had not seen for a long time, and he could clearly feel that some unprecedented talent was awakening in his body.
The seven orifices are exquisite!
